"The next day Gregorio Brice sent by a trumpet a present of ice and fruit to the Prince de Conde, humbly beseeching his highness to excuse his not returning the serenade which he was pleased to favour him with, as unfortunately he had no violins; but that if the music of last night was not disagreeable to him, he would endeavour to continue it as long as he did him the honour to remain before the place.

arxiv-1810-02694.title: Prediction for 5 + ⁣ + 5^{++} mesons
arxiv-1810-02694.creator: Cheng-Qun Pang 1, Ya-Rong Wang 1, Chao-Hui Wang 1
arxiv-1810-02694.description: Abstract In this paper, we study the spectrum and decay behavior of 5 + ⁣ + 5^{++} meson family which is still missing in experiment. By the modified Godfrey-Isgur model with a color screening effect, we obtain the mass spectrum of a 5 a_{5} , f 5 f_{5} and f 5 ′ f_{5}^{\prime} mesons.

arxiv-2003-06880.title: Enumerating Grammar-Based Extractions Journal: Discrete Applied Mathematics
arxiv-2003-06880.creator: Liat Peterfreund
arxiv-2003-06880.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Liat Peterfreund. We propose a new grammar-based language for defining information extractors from documents (text) that is built upon the well-studied framework of document spanners for extracting structured data from text. While previously studied formalisms for document spanners are mainly based on regular expressions, we use an extension of context-free grammars, called extraction grammars, to define the new class of context-free spanners. Extraction grammars are simply context-free grammars extended with variables that capture interval positions of the document, namely spans.

arxiv-2109-14462.title: Off-shell extended graphic rule and the expansion of Berends-Giele currents in Yang-Mills theory
arxiv-2109-14462.creator: Konglong Wu, Yi-Jian Du
arxiv-2109-14462.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Konglong Wu, Yi-Jian Du. Tree-level color-ordered Yang-Mills (YM) amplitudes can be decomposed in terms of ( n − 2 ) ! bi-scalar (BS) amplitudes, whose expansion coefficients form a basis of Bern-Carrasco-Johansson (BCJ) numerators. By the help of the recursive expansion of Einstein-Yang-Mills (EYM) amplitudes, the BCJ numerators are given by polynomial functions of Lorentz contractions which are conveniently described by graphic rule. In this work, we extend the expansion of YM amplitudes to off-shell level.

arxiv-2112-00456.title: Lecture Notes on Complexity of Quantifier Elimination over the Reals
arxiv-2112-00456.creator: Nicolai Vorobjov
arxiv-2112-00456.description: Abstract Introduction These are lecture notes for a course I gave in mid-1990s for MSc students at the University of Bath. It presents an algorithm with singly exponential complexity for the existential theory of the reals, in the spirit of J. Renegar [ 7 ] . Some ideas are borrowed from [ 6 ] and [ 5 ] .

arxiv-2112-09064.title: Elementary Solution of Kepler Problem (and a few other problems)
arxiv-2112-09064.creator: M. Moriconi
arxiv-2112-09064.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by M. Moriconi. We present a simple method to obtain the solution of a few orbital problems: the Kepler problem, the modified Kepler problem by the addition of an inverse square potential and linear force.

arxiv-2301-11975.title: Byte Pair Encoding for Symbolic Music
arxiv-2301-11975.creator: Nathan Fradet, Nicolas Gutowski, Fabien Chhel, Jean-Pierre Briot
arxiv-2301-11975.description: Abstract When used with deep learning, the symbolic music modality is often coupled with language model architectures. To do so, the music needs to be tokenized, i.e. converted into a sequence of discrete tokens. This can be achieved by different approaches, as music can be composed of simultaneous tracks, of simultaneous notes with several attributes.

arxiv-2308-08486.title: Nontrivial Aharonov-Bohm effect and alternating dispersion of magnons in cone-state ferromagnetic rings
arxiv-2308-08486.creator: Vera Uzunova, Lukas Körber, Agapi Kavvadia, Gwendolyn Quasebarth, Helmut Schultheiss, Attila Kákay, Boris Ivanov
arxiv-2308-08486.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Vera Uzunova, Lukas Körber, Agapi Kavvadia, Gwendolyn Quasebarth, Helmut Schultheiss, Attila Kákay, Boris Ivanov. Soft magnetic dots in the form of thin rings have unique topological properties. They can be in a vortex state with no vortex core. Here, we study the magnon modes of such systems both analytically and numerically. In an external magnetic field, magnetic rings are characterized by easy-cone magnetization and shows a giant splitting of doublets for modes with the opposite value of the azimuthal mode quantum number.

arxiv-2502-16900.title: Broadband directional thermal emission with anisothermal microsources
arxiv-2502-16900.creator: F. Herz, R. Messina, P. Ben-Abdallah
arxiv-2502-16900.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by F. Herz, R. Messina, P. Ben-Abdallah. Thermal emission is naturally spatially incoherent and lacks directionality. Here, we demonstrate that by precisely controlling the spatial temperature distribution within a solid, directional thermal emission can be achieved across a broad spectral range. These anisothermal sources open new avenues for manipulating radiative heat flux at the microscale and hold promise for applications in thermal management and energy conversion, enabling more efficient and targeted thermal control.

arxiv-2505-17148.title: LLM-Powered Agents for Navigating Venice’s Historical Cadastre
arxiv-2505-17148.creator: Tristan Karch, Jakhongir Saydaliev, Isabella di Lenardo, Frédéric Kaplan
arxiv-2505-17148.description: Abstract Cadastral data reveal key information about the historical organization of cities but are often non-standardized due to diverse formats and human annotations, complicating large-scale analysis. We explore as a case study Venice’s urban history during the critical period from 1740 to 1808, capturing the transition following the fall of the ancient Republic and the Ancien Régime.

arxiv-2508-21409.title: Analysis of quantities determining the critical inverse temperature in the annealed Potts model with Pareto vertex weights
arxiv-2508-21409.creator: A.J.E.M. Janssen
arxiv-2508-21409.description: Abstract Abstract. We consider in this work the crucial quantity t_{c} that determines the critical inverse temperature \beta_{c} in the q -state Potts model on sparse rank-1 random graphs where the vertices are equipped with a Pareto weight densty (\tau-1)\,w^{-\tau}\,{\cal X}_{[1,\infty)}(w) .

arxiv-2510-17982.title: Interplay of Noise and Reservoir-induced Decoherence in Persistent Currents
arxiv-2510-17982.creator: Samudra Sur, Thierry Giamarchi
arxiv-2510-17982.description: Abstract Persistent current is a hallmark of quantum phase coherence. We study the fate of the persistent current in a non-equilibrium setting, where a tight-binding ring is subjected to stochastic disorder as well as a fermionic reservoir attached to each site.

oviedo-historia-general-natural-vol-3-18.title: Historia general y natural de las Indias, Vol. 3
oviedo-historia-general-natural-vol-3-18.creator: Gonzalo Fernández de Oviedo
oviedo-historia-general-natural-vol-3-18.description: Oviedo's Historia general y natural (1535-57) - the Spanish crown's official chronicler; the first natural history of the New World. No PD English translation exists; the Royal Academy of History edition (Madrid, 1851-55, Spanish), staged as a PD documentary text. Vol. 3 of 4.

pmc-11419789.title: Evaluating the Association between Anemia and the Severity of Liver Disease in Children with Cirrhosis: A Cross-Sectional Study from 2015 to 2020
pmc-11419789.creator: Seyed Mohsen Dehghani, Iraj Shahramian, Hamideh Salehi, Leila Kasraian, Maryam Ataollahi, Masoud Tahani
pmc-11419789.description: PurposeLiver cirrhosis is a major cause of hospital admission and mortality among children. Understanding the factors that influence disease severity is essential for preventing and reducing mortality. This study explored the association between hemoglobin levels and liver disease severity in children with cirrhosis.MethodsThis cross-sectional study included 326 children with cirrhosis admitted to Namazi Teaching Hospital between 2015 and 2020.

pmc-11470689.title: Cryopreservation of bovine sperm causes single-strand DNA breaks that are localized in the toroidal regions of chromatin
pmc-11470689.creator: Jordi Ribas-Maynou, Rodrigo Muiño, Carolina Tamargo, Marc Yeste
pmc-11470689.description: BackgroundSperm cryopreservation is widely used in the cattle industry, as it allows for disassociating the localization of sires and the collection of semen from the timing of artificial insemination. While freeze-thawing is known to impair sperm DNA integrity, whether the damage induced consists of single- (SSB) or double-strand breaks (DSB) has not been determined.

pmc-12530450.title: Validation of Telehealth Outcome Categories for Patient Safety: Systematic Literature Review
pmc-12530450.creator: Sari Palojoki, Lasse Lehtonen, Riikka Vuokko, Arriel Benis
pmc-12530450.description: BackgroundIntegrating telehealth into established care processes can be challenging. With the integration of telehealth into routine health care practices, there is a growing need to evaluate telehealth outcomes to understand its impact on health care delivery. However, existing literature on telehealth outcomes to support evaluation remains limited.

pmc-12829165.title: Comparative β-cell development: insights from Rodents, humans and induced pluripotent stem cell models
pmc-12829165.creator: Radwan Darwish, Yasmine Alcibahy, Manjula Nandakumar, Alexandra E. Butler, Abu Saleh Md Moin
pmc-12829165.description: Stepwise pancreatic β-cell differentiation protocols, designed to recapitulate key developmental milestones of pancreatic organogenesis—from definitive endoderm to mature, glucose-responsive β-cells—draw on insights from both rodent and human developmental biology. These protocols consist of three critical stages: the formation of definitive endoderm, the induction of pancreatic progenitors, and the maturation of functional β-cells.

pmc-12951468.title: Metal–organic framework (MOF)-embedded magnetic polysaccharide hydrogel beads for rapid and selective adsorption of malachite green and crystal violet
pmc-12951468.creator: Anni Fang, Jie Gao, Yunzhu Lu, Lidong Wu, Lei Cheng
pmc-12951468.description: This study aims to tackle water pollution caused by toxic triphenylmethane dyes—specifically malachite green (MG) and crystal violet (CV)—by developing a metal–organic framework (MOF)-based magnetic hydrogel microsphere (MMOF) using sodium alginate as the matrix. Magnetic MOF particles were embedded into the sodium alginate hydrogel to form porous, stable magnetic microsphere adsorbents.

pmc-13146380.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A977 THE RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN PHYSICAL ACTIVITY LEVELS AND PAIN COPING STRATEGIES AMONG STROKE SURVIVORS OF BANGLADESH: A CROSS-SECTIONAL STUDY
pmc-13146380.creator: M D Borhan Sohan
pmc-13146380.description: BackgroundRehabilitation becomes more difficult after a stroke, which causes long-term disability worldwide and is especially difficult in nations like Bangladesh that lack adequate resources. While functional recovery depends on physical activity (PA), inappropriate pain coping strategies can reduce its efficacy. Improving recovery outcomes can be accomplished by gaining an understanding of relationship between PA levels and pain coping strategies.

pmc-13223807.title: Effects of combined ultrasonic and microwave pretreatments on vacuum freeze-drying efficiency and quality of giant freshwater prawn (Macrobrachium rosenbergii)
pmc-13223807.creator: Ruili Yuan, Zhiyu Xiong, Li Yuan, Wengang Jin, Ling Jiang, Ruichang Gao
pmc-13223807.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The trade-off between drying efficiency and product quality poses a major challenge in dried prawn processing. Vacuum freeze-drying (VFD) effectively retains the nutritional and sensory quality of aquatic products, yet its industrial application is restricted by high energy consumption. To address this, we investigated the individual and combined effects of ultrasound (US) and microwave (MW) pretreatment on the drying kinetics, energy consumption and comprehensive quality of prawn during VFD.

pmc-13293655.title: CATS—A tool to contextualize cancer hallmarks to specific cancer types
pmc-13293655.creator: Mahfuza Sharmin, Gulden Olgun, Piyush Agrawal, Arashdeep Singh, Sridhar Hannenhalli

pmc-13334206.title: Effects of A‐PRF+ Extract at Different Concentrations on the Metabolic Activity and Migration of Dental Pulp Stem Cells in Irreversible Pulpitis: An In Vitro Study
pmc-13334206.creator: Duyen Ngoc-Minh Tran, Minh Duc Nguyen, Ninh Hai Truong, Giang Thanh Pham, Thinh Viet Vo, Hoang Minh Lam, My Thi-Ngoc Nguyen, Ha Le-Bao Tran, Lan Thi-Quynh Ngo, Khue Ngoc Luong, Anh Thi-Nguyet Nguyen
pmc-13334206.description: BackgroundVital pulp therapy (VPT) in mature permanent teeth with irreversible pulpitis represents a paradigm shift toward preserving pulp vitality. Advanced platelet‐rich fibrin plus (A‐PRF+) is a bioactive scaffold capable of releasing high concentrations of growth factors; however, its concentration‐dependent effects on inflamed pulp‐derived stem cells remain unclear.

pmc-13542605.title: Treatment and survival of de novo HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer across regional cancer networks in the Netherlands: a cohort study
pmc-13542605.creator: N Ding, SME Geurts, KEPE Hermans, IJH Vriens, R Visserman, LFS Kooreman, NAJB Peters, EM Heuts, J Verloop, AC Voogd, VCG Tjan-Heijnen
pmc-13542605.description: BackgroundHuman epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-targeted therapy has improved survival in HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer (MBC). Real-world practice may differ across oncologic networks, even within countries with uniform treatment guidelines. We assessed regional variation in first-line treatment and overall survival (OS) among patients with de novo HER2-positive MBC in the Netherlands in 2013-2023.

pmc-13617888.title: Risk factors for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis: an umbrella review of meta-analyses and mendelian randomization analyses
pmc-13617888.creator: Huanrong Ruan, Siyuan Lei, Jun Wang, Hulei Zhao, Xuezhong Zhou, Jiansheng Li
pmc-13617888.description: BackgroundThe incidence of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) is rising globally. Existing meta-analyses and Mendelian randomization (MR) studies have yielded inconsistent findings with uncertain evidence quality.ObjectivesThis study aimed to synthesize available evidence and assess its credibility for potential risk factors of IPF.
